facts.business: Priority Jewels Limited is a Mumbai-based B2B fine jewellery manufacturer specialising in lightweight, affordable diamond-studded gold and platinum jewellery, designing, manufacturing and supplying to independent jewellers and organised retail chains across India and select international markets.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Priority Jewels plans to enhance its manufacturing capacity, strengthening its balance sheet through debt deleveraging, leverage strategic collaborations, and expand its design offerings across jewellery categories and price points.
guidance_or_targets.metric: Manufacturing capacity enhancement, debt deleveraging, strategic collaborations, design expansion

auditor.name: M.B. Nayak & Co., Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter: 1) Investment in Subsidiary/Associate - investment in Venice Dia Jewel Private Limited (Subsidiary) and Acura Jewels Private Limited (Subsidiary) of Rs. 0.52 Million each and Brillix Private Limited (Associate) of Rs. 0.24 Million. 2) Pre-IPO Placement of Equity Shares - allotment of 8,25,000 Equity Shares at ₹190 per share aggregating to ₹156.75 Million.

key_risks: Fluctuations in gold, diamond and other raw material prices
Changes in consumer preferences and demand
